days.counts_scope: UTC day; coverage counts intersecting UTC minutes

definitions.name: law M2
definitions.condition: Every canonical UTC day from the cube anchor through the due archive frontier must have activated market state proof. Unactivated additions and absent days never count as coverage.
definitions.evidence_source: law sample active component proofs and bounded reader-selected count query
